name: server/mzizi-data
title: mzizi-data
summary: What every Mzizi database client shares: the transport trait, the error type, the server harness and (on a Worker) the TLS socket. Nothing database-specific.

surface.summary: The byte transport: write_all and read_exact. A protocol core is generic over it and never opens a socket.
Uri, Io, Timeout, Codec, Protocol, Auth, Server, Refused.
Receives a client's events. Pluggable, adaptable, removable.
The harness that does nothing; the default.
One thing that happened: a static name, a level, static-keyed fields.
A field value: a static string, an integer or a flag. Never a runtime string.

guarantees.statement: A harness handed to a client receives that client's events; the default harness ignores them.

harness.secrets: An Event's name and field keys are &'static str, and a string field value is a &'static str, so no connection string, password, collection name or document can be formatted into one. Only integers and flags vary.

gaps: The Postgres and SQLite clients (mzizi-postgres, mzizi-sqlite) do not exist yet; nothing is stubbed.
workers::SocketIo is compiled only for wasm32 with the workers feature, so its contract is held by a type check and clippy for wasm32-unknown-unknown, not by a native test.
